formalized_procedure.quoted: Profile the native paths in FastWAM's fastwam_joint.py/fastwam.py/mot.py and Cosmos' omni_mot_model.py plus the RoboLab policy-server entry point. Separate action-query-to-observation QK/AV, other attention, QKV, FFN, and mask/packing cost; compute phi_obs and its Amdahl upper bound, and stop if measured savings cannot meet the original latency gate.

formalized_procedure.quoted: Use only the token packer's existing camera/view or other source provenance; if it does not expose provenance, stop rather than infer groups. On each chunk's dense first native action evaluation k_ref, read native attention alpha, values V, and output-projection head slices W_O, then compute r_lg and rho_lg; retain all groups if the normalization denominator is zero.
consumes: The dense k_ref attention weights and values
produces: Per-layer source-group r_lg and rho_lg scores
A dense fallback for a zero normalization denominator

This audit reused that record and did not rerun the toy. It verifies only the synthetic scoring rule, not access to these tensors in either fused native attention path.

formalized_procedure.quoted: On held-out selection episodes D_select, sort groups by descending r_lg with native source order breaking ties, and choose epsilon in [0,1) so S_l(epsilon) is the shortest prefix whose cumulative rho_lg reaches 1-epsilon. Subject to the original frozen task-success gate, select the epsilon with the lowest measured full-path latency; if no pre-existing gate applies, report the success-latency curve without declaring a pass.
produces: A frozen per-layer group mask and retained key/value indices
formalized_procedure.stopped_reason: The mask rule is specified, but no held-out episodes, gate values, or measured full-path latencies are available; therefore the epsilon-selection criterion cannot be applied.
formalized_procedure.note: The prior synthetic check used epsilon=0.4 illustratively; it did not select epsilon using task success or measured latency.
formalized_procedure.suggestion: Use the existing held-out split and unchanged gate. Evaluate the distinct prefix-change masks induced by the measured cumulative rho values, choose the lowest-latency mask that passes the existing gate, and report a curve without a pass if no pre-existing gate applies.

formalized_procedure.quoted: For later native action solver evaluations in the chunk, send action queries and retained observation keys/values to a true variable-length or block-sparse kernel and verify omitted QK/AV is not executed. Recompute softmax over retained keys, feed the resulting attention output through the original residual/transformer blocks, and let the changed action hidden state/velocity update the original flow state; leave video-query paths, future/action interactions, FFN, and solver schedule native.
consumes: Native action queries and flow state
produces: The original residual/flow path with changed action updates
Evidence omitted QK/AV was actually skipped

formalized_procedure.note: The residual, flow schedule, video-query, future/action, and FFN paths are explicitly held native; the actual sparse kernel and its per-backend support remain the central engineering gap.
formalized_procedure.suggestion: For each frozen backend, identify or implement the compact kernel at the native joint entry point, preserve the specified retained-key softmax and residual path, and verify omitted QK/AV is not executed. Measure the kernel together with attribution, score, packing, and launch overhead.

formalized_procedure.quoted: On paired evaluation episodes D_eval not used to select epsilon, compare dense, rho_lg-ranked, and same-retained-edge-cost source-group-permutation masks, alongside native attention-mass, ToPi/VATP value-norm, and CAPA output-projected score controls. Use the same frozen checkpoint, k_ref dense forward, exact retained edge budget, and compact kernel; record task success, per-path FLOPs, full latency including scoring/packing/kernel launch, action-chunk deviation, and first action divergence, then apply the original frozen gates. Require a legally matched-cost source-group permutation; if existing provenance groups do not permit one, report that control as unavailable rather than substitute an unequal-cost arm.
consumes: S3/S4 masks and same-cost scoring controls
produces: Per-backbone paired success, cost, and divergence results
A stop/retain decision under unchanged gates
